name: Creamy Shrimp & Veggie Soup with Crackers (Prep-Ahead)

ingredients.name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes 3 medium and 3 small food storage containers.
Wash, dry, peel, and trim carrots; small dice. Place in a medium bowl.
Wash, dry, trim, and small dice celery. Add to the bowl with the carrot.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the veggies.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, garlic, and spices to the pan; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp thyme, dried
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add broth to the pan, stir to combine the soup, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender, about 5 minutes.

Meanwhile, if using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry. Roughly chop.
instructions.secondary_message: 454 g raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are tender, add shrimp to the pan with the soup and continue to simmer until cooked through, about 3 minutes.
While the shrimp are cooking, using a clean cutting board, small dice cream cheese.
When the shrimp are done, add cream cheese to the pan. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the cheese is melted and combined, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Divide crackers between the small containers, cover, and set aside.

Divide soup between the medium storage containers, then set aside to cool completely, about 1 hour. Once cool, cover containers and refrigerate. When ready to eat, heat soup in a saucepan or microwave, serve with crackers, and enjoy!
